name: Barbell Incline Row
steps: Set an adjustable bench to roughly a 30-to-45-degree incline and lie chest-down with your feet anchored firmly on the floor.
Grasp the barbell beneath the bench with a wider-than-shoulder overhand grip and straight arms.
Drive your elbows back to pull the bar up toward the underside of the bench while squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension without lifting your chest off the pad.
tips: Keep your neck neutral in line with your upper back rather than craning upward.
Avoid jerking your torso off the bench to finish heavy repetitions.
